about: EVERY REPORT THE LIVE BLOCK WRITES, AND WHERE (the owner 2026-10-27 13:22: "the rules for this are outside sanity and replaced so they can be deleted and self heal if they are gone"; the original's schemas/reports.json, its shape): one entry a report: name, path ({root} is root below, {office} this office's own name), writer, every, max_age (hours: older than this the LIVE block is RED, the writer stopped; null: written on a draw, its age says nothing), kind (replaced whole: written over at each write; appended: a log its writer adds lines to). All live outside ~/virtual_sanity; any may be deleted at any time: its writer writes it again (the next look of the LIVE writes every one it holds), and the panel says a missing one NOT WRITTEN YET, never an error. Written only by a served page holding an agent. The platform's manifest.json stays the platform's, read where it is, never copied here.

reports.name: system
reports.writer: frame/frame_live.py, the machine sampler (CPU, LOAD, MEMORY, DISK, NETWORK)
reports.every: every 5 seconds on a served page

reports.name: offices
reports.writer: frame/frame_live.py, the offices look (each office, its port, its api)
reports.every: every 15 seconds on a served page

reports.name: panel
reports.writer: frame/frame_live.py panel, the panel's data at a draw (what runs now, the five tools, today's work)

reports.name: look
reports.writer: frame/frame_live.py look, the LIVE's own look at its stream (green or red, its words)
reports.every: every 300 seconds, its first 20 seconds after the start

reports.name: look_log
reports.writer: frame/frame_live.py look, one line a look
